basic_details.job_title: Kalaburagi District Court Typist Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Court of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Kalaburagi (Kalaburagi District Court), Karnataka, has invited applications for 2 posts of Typist under Advt No. ಜಿನ್ಯಾಕ/ಆಡಳಿತ/21/2026. The online application is open from 16 November 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through SBI Collect via net banking, credit card, debit card or UPI; challan, DD, postal order and money order not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum 18 years; maximum not exceeding 35+5* years (General), 38+5* years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5* years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receipt of applications)

qualification.education_qualification: Pass in Second Year PUC (Pre-University Education Department) or Diploma in Commercial Practice (Karnataka Board of Technical Examinations) or equivalent; AND pass in Kannada and English Typewriting Senior Grade (Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka) or Diploma in Commercial Practice with Kannada and English typewriting as optional subjects, or equivalent.
qualification.details: Qualification: Passed Second Year Pre-University Course examination conducted by the Pre-University Education Department, or Diploma in Commercial Practice conducted by the Karnataka Board of Technical Examinations, or equivalent qualification, on the last date for applications; Passed Kannada and English Typewriting Senior Grade conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka, or Diploma in Commercial Practice (KBTE) with Kannada and English typewriting as optional subjects, or equivalent qualification Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum not exceeding 35+5* years (General), 38+5* years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5* years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receipt of applications) Age relaxation: General 35+5* years, Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B 38+5* years, SC/ST/Category-1 40+5* years, One-time measure 5 years in upper age limit as per GO No. CASUI 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, Karnataka Government / local authority / state corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census Organisation employees in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less | Other conditions: | SSLC / 2nd PUC grades or CGPA must be converted to marks and entered with maximum marks, marks obtained and percentage

salary_details.pay_scale: Pay scale Rs. 34100-67600 and other allowances

how_to_apply: Apply only online through the link on https://kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16.11.2026 and 15.12.2026 (11.59 PM).
Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and an email ID if available.
Upload a scanned recent colour photo (5 cm x 3.6 cm, 50 KB, light background) and signature in black ballpoint pen on white paper.
Pay the fee through SBI Collect (net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI) by 17.12.2026.
Download the application and keep it with the SBI e-pay receipt until the recruitment ends.
important_instructions: Applications without fee payment will be rejected Fee once paid will not be refunded Eligible candidates will be informed by SMS and email; the authority is not responsible for non-delivery Download the eligible list from the website and produce it at the interview Fraud or false information leads to cancellation, criminal and disciplinary action No correspondence with the office; enquiries on 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM)

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Passed Second Year Pre-University Course examination conducted by the Pre-University Education Department, or Diploma in Commercial Practice conducted by the Karnataka Board of Technical Examinations, or equivalent qualification, on the last date for applications; Passed Kannada and English Typewriting Senior Grade conducted by the Department of Public Instruction, Government of Karnataka, or Diploma in Commercial Practice (KBTE) with Kannada and English typewriting as optional subjects, or equivalent qualification Age limit: Minimum 18 years; maximum not exceeding 35+5* years (General), 38+5* years (Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B), 40+5* years (SC/ST/Category-1) (as on the last date fixed for receipt of applications) Age relaxation: General 35+5* years, Category 2A, 2B, 3A, 3B 38+5* years, SC/ST/Category-1 40+5* years, One-time measure 5 years in upper age limit as per GO No. CASUI 262 SENENI 2025 dated 29.01.2026, Karnataka Government / local authority / state corporation employees Years of service or 10 years, whichever is less, Ex-servicemen Years of service in armed forces plus 3 years, Persons with disabilities, widows, bonded labourers 10 years, Census Organisation employees in Karnataka Years of service or 5 years, whichever is less Other conditions: SSLC / 2nd PUC grades or CGPA must be converted to marks and entered with maximum marks, marks obtained and percentage

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who obtain certificates after the last date or in forms other than prescribed (except Kannada medium study certificate) lose the reservation or candidature

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Probation of 2 years under the Karnataka Civil Services (Probation) Rules, 1977 Must pass the departmental examinations prescribed for the post and the Kannada language examination during probation Must pass the computer literacy test with 50% marks before completing probation

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through SBI Collect via net banking, credit card, debit card or UPI; challan, DD, postal order and money order not accepted. Last date to pay the fee: 17 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will Kalaburagi District Court Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competency test: dictation in Kannada and English at 120 words per minute for 5 minutes, transcribed on computer within 45 minutes Interview (10 marks) Dictation of 5 minutes at 120 words per minute in Kannada and English, then transcription on computer within 45 minutes Competency test carries 100 marks each in Kannada and English; minimum 50 marks in both to pass Interview carries 10 marks List of candidates eligible for interview will be published on the court website

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: SBI e-pay receipt of the fee SSLC marks card / transfer certificate / cumulative record for date of birth Caste or category certificate in the prescribed form, if claiming reservation Ex-servicemen release certificate; widow or bonded labourer certificate; disability certificate from district medical board, as applicable Two conduct certificates from respectable persons within 6 months of the application date and a school conduct certificate No Objection Certificate for in-service candidates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Kalaburagi District Court Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply only online through the link on https://kalaburagi.dcourts.gov.in/Judges/online-recruitment/ between 16.11.2026 and 15.12.2026 (11.59 PM). Enter a mobile number (mandatory) and an email ID if available. Upload a scanned recent colour photo (5 cm x 3.6 cm, 50 KB, light background) and signature in black ballpoint pen on white paper. Pay the fee through SBI Collect (net banking, credit card, debit card, UPI) by 17.12.2026. Download the application and keep it with the SBI e-pay receipt until the recruitment ends.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications without fee payment will be rejected Fee once paid will not be refunded Eligible candidates will be informed by SMS and email; the authority is not responsible for non-delivery Download the eligible list from the website and produce it at the interview Fraud or false information leads to cancellation, criminal and disciplinary action No correspondence with the office; enquiries on 08472 221856 (10.00 AM to 6.00 PM)
